translation.name: Xchiʼdxyi cuubi dxiohs nin bieʼgaluuʼyi daada Jesucristu (El Nuevo Testamento en el zapoteco de Chichicapan y en español)

book.name: San Lucas
book.title: Dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin bacaꞌh San Lucas xcweenta Jesucristu

content: Rrieezgu chuuꞌ xtuhlda raꞌ bwiinn
Rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh: ―Nahpa nuu cohsa raꞌ nin ruhnn pur riuuꞌ xtuhlda raꞌ bwiinn, per prohbiza bwiinn nin rguꞌtii laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn loh duhlda.
Xlawaaꞌha chyu gusaaꞌn gusaguiꞌhi stuhbi bwiinn laꞌh biñiꞌn chuu xtuhlda bi, mejor guchiꞌbi raꞌ ba tuhbi dxiahrooꞌ yahnn nin rusaguiꞌhi chi tin gulaꞌha raꞌ ba laꞌh ba loh ñihsadoꞌ.
Gulgahca nasiin. Sidela bwihtsi tu guñihchi loh tu, gulguiñiꞌ loh bi pur nin bwiꞌhnn bi, ya sidela gadxaꞌh xigaaba bi mejor gusiaꞌldastoꞌ tu nin bwiꞌhnn bi.
Nicala gahdzi bweelta guñihchi bi loh tu ya gahdziza bweelta dxiꞌ bi tin nnaa bi: “Ayiru gabiaꞌgarii guꞌnnañin stuhbi”, nahpa gusiaꞌldastoꞌ luꞌh nin bwiꞌhnn bi.
Cohsarooru nin zahca guunn tuhbi bwiinn nin riachiistoꞌ ñiꞌh xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs
Chiꞌchi rahbi nin naa raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh loh Ñiꞌh: ―Daada, gacanee luꞌh laꞌh nu tin mahziru chechiistoꞌ nu xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs.

Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba: ―Sidela laꞌh tu ñachiistoꞌ tu xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs, mahz balaaquiꞌhn ziga tuhbi bwiiꞌdzi biꞌtuhn xteenn mortahsa ñahca ñahbi tu loh yahgaroo ca: “Biyaꞌdxu riꞌca tin bwaa galaayi loh ñihsadoꞌ riꞌchi soobaa luꞌh”, guzoꞌbadxiahgan xchiꞌdxyi tu.
Nin xchiꞌhn guunn tuhbi mooza
Rahbiza Ñiꞌh: ―¿Chyu tuhbi tu nahpa tuhbi mooza nin raaꞌn o nin rahpa guidxaꞌh ya gahbi bwiinn chi loh ba chin gabiaꞌgarii ba loh dahan: “Rii gudaaꞌ, soobaa luꞌh tin gahw luꞌh”?

Pwehda ayi nin tuhbi bwiinn nin guiñiꞌ ziꞌchi. Pwehda gahbi tu: “Bwiꞌhnnchaꞌyi xi gahwxchiin neezaa nin gueeꞌhehn, chiꞌchi gacu luꞌh xahba nayaa luꞌh tin cwaachi luꞌh xi gaawuhn loh mweella, ya chin chaꞌloh gaawuhn chiꞌchi gahwgaꞌh luꞌh yiꞌh neezaa guee luꞌh.”
Ya guidiaꞌhan nuꞌh ¿gu nuu tuhbi bwiinn nin rahbi: “Zuxchilli luꞌh saca bwiꞌhnn luꞌh niꞌca”? Guyaa, pwehda ayi nin tuhbi bwiinn nin guiñiꞌ ziꞌchi.

Ziꞌchi gahcaza laꞌh tu, chin chaꞌloh guunn tu garaa dziꞌn raꞌ nin gunabwaꞌ Dxiohs loh tu, nahpa guiñiꞌ tu loh Dxiohs: “Laꞌhnu naa nu mooza nin ayi xi lasahca laasii bidiꞌhnnzi nu cohsa raꞌ nin nahpa guidiꞌhnn nu.”
Basiaca Jesuhs tsiꞌh bwiinn nin rahchyi guiiꞌdxiu tihxi raꞌ Ñiꞌh
Gaduhbi zezah Jesuhs neziuh nin zee guihdxyi Jerusalehn, gudiiꞌdxi Ñiꞌh loh rregiohn Samaria cun loh rregiohn Galilea.
Ya chin guyuꞌtii Ñiꞌh tuhbi guihdxyi biꞌtuꞌhn chiꞌchi gwagachaꞌloh tsiꞌh bwiinn raꞌ nin rahchyi guiiꞌdxiu tihxi raꞌ Ñiꞌh laꞌh Ñiꞌh, zihturu guchiꞌloh raꞌ ba laꞌh Jesuhs,
chiꞌchi guñiꞌ raꞌ ba jweersi, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―¡Jesuhs, mwehsu! ¡Balahsastoꞌ luꞌh laꞌh nu!

Ya chin bwaꞌha Jesuhs laꞌh raꞌ ba, chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Gulchee hasta nuu bixohza tin gulgaluuꞌyi laꞌh ba laꞌtu biaca. Ya gaduhbi zee raꞌ ba zegaluuꞌyi tihxi raꞌ ba laꞌh bixohza ziga nanchii laꞌguiiꞌdxiu chi guñihchilohtiiꞌ tihxi raꞌ ba.
Ya tuhbi ba chin bwaꞌha ba laꞌba biaca, talguꞌnsi gubiaꞌgarii ba ziaa ba hasta zuu Jesuhs, gaduhbi ziagazah ba guzaꞌloh rñiꞌ ba jweersi, rahbi ba: ―¡Dxiohssihn chuhla naa!
Ya chin badzihn ba hasta zuu Jesuhs, bazuꞌnllihbi ba baruꞌhn ba hasta loh yuh nez loh Jesuhs tin cagadiꞌhi ba guelzuxchilli loh Ñiꞌh. Ya coma bwiinn chi bwiinnziitu ba, bwiinn rregiohn Samaria ba,
chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh ba: ―Per ¿tayi tsiꞌdxiꞌh naa tu biaca tu? ¿Cuunxchiꞌh zagaꞌ tu?
¿Ta tuhbidxiꞌh bwiinnziitu riiꞌ gubiaꞌgarii zeꞌganiꞌhi guelzuxchilli saca nin biaca ba?
Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh bwiinn chi: ―Gwasuꞌnchii tin bwaa. Laꞌluꞌh biaca nnah laasii gwachiistoꞌ luꞌh xchiꞌdxyiꞌhn.
Xa gadzihn xquelrnabwaꞌ Dxiohs
Chiꞌchi gunabadxiꞌdxyi raꞌ bwiinn loh Jesuhs cuuca gadzihn xquelrnabwaꞌ Dxiohs, chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba: ―Dxyih nin saꞌloh guinabwaꞌ Dxiohs guidxyiyuh ayi gacan tuhbi sehn nin gacabwaꞌ tu,
tin par ayi gaca guiñiꞌ tu: “Riiꞌ cayahca niꞌca”, o gahbi tu: “Riꞌchi cayahcan”, laasii dez nnah laꞌDxiohs canabwaꞌla paaldaa bwiinn nin dxaꞌga loh tu.

Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh: ―Ziuuꞌ tuhbi dxyih nin guiclaaꞌdzi tu gwaꞌha tu naꞌh, nin naan Lliiꞌn Dxiohs nin naa ndxiꞌhw, gabiaꞌgariin loh guidxyiyuh tin guinabwaꞌn; nicala tuhbidxiꞌh dxyih guiclaaꞌdzi tu gwaꞌha tu naꞌh per ayi gaca gwaꞌha tu naꞌh.
Nee ziuuꞌza tuhbi nin guiñiꞌ loh tu: “Riiꞌ laꞌba nuu”, o “Riꞌchi laꞌba nuu”, per rñaan loh tu ayi chee tu nen ayiza chenaꞌhla tu laꞌh ba
tin zahca ziga rahca chin rdxiñaaꞌh llaaꞌndxibaaꞌ.
Per galoh gaca raꞌ cohsa chi nahpa gutiꞌdxilohxgah ba trabahjw. Ya garaa bwiinn raꞌ nin rii guidxyiyuh nnah, guidxyiꞌchinee raꞌ ba cun gusaꞌcazii raꞌ ba laꞌh ba.
Ziga nin guhca chin guyuuꞌ tuhbi bwiinn chieemparooꞌ nin biriaꞌlah Noeh, ziꞌchi gahcaza gaca chin guibiaꞌgariin, ziga naan Lliiꞌn Dxiohs nin naa ndxiꞌhw.

Laꞌn dxyih raꞌ nin gubahan guehtu Noeh chi, garaa bwiinn gudahw raꞌ ba gwaaꞌ raꞌ ba, bachinaa raꞌ ba guleꞌdxiꞌhn lliiꞌndxaꞌpa raꞌ ba gucaꞌha biꞌnxtuhbi raꞌ tin bachinaa raꞌ bi hasta badzihn dxyih chin guyuuꞌtii Noeh laꞌn barcurooꞌ nin bwiꞌhnnchaꞌyi gahca ba. Chiꞌchi badzihn tuhbi ñihsadxiahxihn gudxiinnan laꞌh garaa raꞌ bwiinn nin ayi bwiꞌhnn cweenta xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs.
Ziꞌchi gahcaza guhca laꞌn dxyih raꞌ chin gubahan guehtu Lot: Snuhn raꞌ bwiinn gudahw gwaaꞌ raꞌ ba, guziꞌ raꞌ ba nee batooꞌ raꞌ ba, gulahchi raꞌ ba biñih bwiꞌhnnchaꞌyi raꞌza ba yuuꞌ,
ya chin bariaꞌh Lot loh guihdxyi Sodoma, guzaꞌloh biaaba dxih llaaꞌndxibaaꞌ cun cobadehldaꞌh, bañihchilohon garaa raꞌ bwiinn duhlda nin ayi bwiꞌhnn cweenta xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs.
Ziꞌchi gahcaza gaca laꞌn dxyih raꞌ chin guibiaꞌgarii Lliiꞌn Dxiohs nin naa ndxiꞌhw.

Ya laꞌn dxyih raꞌ chi sidela chyuulla caa yihca yihdzi Ñiꞌh nen nahpa ba xilla laꞌn yuuꞌ mejor ayi guunn ba pur chegaleꞌhe ban, mahzi lwehgu guzee ba. Ya sidela chyuulla zuu loh dahan, mejor ayi guibiaꞌgariiru yihdzi ba; talguꞌnsi guzee ba.
¿Tayi riagannastoꞌ tu xi guhca cheꞌhla guehtu Lot?
Ya nin guiclaaꞌdzi gaapa xquelnabahan ñiꞌh loh guidxyiyuh riiꞌ, zuñihchi ban; per nin gudziꞌba xquelnabahan ñiꞌh loh guidxyiyuh riiꞌ xcweenta xchiꞌdxyi raꞌn, zahpa ba guelnabahan llaaꞌndxibaaꞌ.
Ñaan loh tu, dxyih nin gabiaꞌgarii Lliiꞌn Dxiohs nin naa ndxiꞌhw gaca ziga naꞌ chiohpa bwiinn loh tuhbi daaꞌ, tuhbisi ba guzee ya stuhbi ba dxiaꞌncah;
o loh chiohpa gunnaꞌh nin riiyuhta, tuhbisi ba guzee ya stuhbi ba dxiaꞌhan;
neezaa chiohpa bwiinn raꞌ nin rii loh dahan, tuhbisi ba guzee ya stuhbi ba dxiaꞌhan.

Ya chin bihn raꞌ ba dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ chi, chiꞌchi gunabadxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―Daada, ¿canehz gaca raꞌ cohsa riiꞌ? Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs: ―Hasta naꞌ raꞌ bwiinnguuchi, riꞌchi gadiaaꞌha raꞌ bwiichi.
